name: Artillerist
summary: An artificer specialized in hurling energy and building magical cannons.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.summary: You gain proficiency with woodcarver's tools.

features.name: Artillerist Spells
features.short: Blast spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have certain spells prepared after you reach particular levels in this class. They don't count against the number of artificer spells you prepare.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.short: Create a small cannon: flamethrower, force ballista or protector.
features.summary: As an action, you create a Small or Tiny eldritch cannon for 1 hour. Choose flamethrower (15 ft. cone, 2d8 fire, DEX save), force ballista (ranged spell attack, 2d8 force, push 5 ft.) or protector (1d8 + INT temp HP to creatures within 10 ft.). As a bonus action you make it act. Once per long rest for free, or by spending a spell slot.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.short: Add 1d8 to one damage roll of your artificer spells.
features.summary: You carve a wand, staff or rod into an arcane firearm. When you cast an artificer spell through it, add 1d8 to one of the spell's damage rolls.

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.short: Cannon damage +1d8; detonate it for 3d8 force.
features.summary: Your cannon's damage rolls increase by 1d8. As an action, you can detonate it: each creature within 20 ft. makes a DEX save, taking 3d8 force damage on a failure, half on a success.

features.name: Fortified Position
features.short: Run two cannons; allies near them get half cover.
features.summary: You and your allies have half cover while within 10 ft. of a cannon you create. You can have two cannons at once, creating both with one action, and activate both with one bonus action.
